title: Can a flier flock exceed the written cluster range? E42 (T8b) saw one raven flock of three under trickle's standing {2,1} write. Two arms, a season each: the land roster closed to BIRD_RAVEN only, and to BIRD_EMU only (a flightless bird of the same category), both under the trickle pattern so the write stands on the one species; every surface wave sized from arrivals within 500 ticks. If ravens run over and emus never do, the cluster raw is not the field DF sizes a flier flock from.
fork: Is cluster_number a hard ceiling for a flier flock, as E12 showed it is for emu.

predictions.expects: raven waves of 3+ appear in both replicates; every emu wave is 1-2
every wave in both arms is 1-2

kill_criterion: any wave above 2 in the raven arm with none in the emu arm, in both replicate pairs, makes the raw a soft ceiling for fliers
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save
a replicate with fewer than three surface waves is too thin to read

arms.name: raven
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.layers.land=true; cfg.layers.water=false; cfg.layers.cavern=false; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n=0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and sw.defaultAllow(e) then cfg.allow[e.key]=true; n=n+1 end end; local a=sw.assignFromMatrix(cfg,pool); for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and e.layer=='land' then cfg.allow[e.key]=(e.token=='BIRD_RAVEN'); if e.token=='BIRD_RAVEN' then cfg.assign[e.key]={0,1,2,3} end end end; cfg.groups.enabled=true; cfg.groups.coupling=false; cfg.groups.pack=0; cfg.groups.max_concurrent=4; cfg.groups.cavern=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; cfg.patterns.land='trickle'; sw.saveConfig(cfg); local act=sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); local w=sw.PATTERN.trickleApply(cfg,true); local cr; for _,c in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if c.creature_id=='BIRD_RAVEN' then cr=c end end; print(('e42b roster: land closed to BIRD_RAVEN only (applied %d); trickle standing on %s species; BIRD_RAVEN cluster raw now {%d,%d}'):format(act,tostring(w),cr.cluster_number[0],cr.cluster_number[1]))
